acceptance: go/internal/faketmux has no exec of ps
go test -count=1 ./internal/faketmux passes inside a lane cell (the build floor of the cycle)
TestClaimIn_ReapsOnlyTheMarkedRunsWhoseOwnerIsGone still fails when the reaper signals a group that the pane does not lead
fix: Read the process command and group through internal/proctree (faketmux already imports it), not through an exec of ps. Read the real proctree exports first. Keep the reaper's rules: it signals a pane group only while the pane leads it and it is not our own group.
summary: Cycle 2513 audit H1: commandOf (go/internal/faketmux/session.go:31-32) execs /bin/ps, and a lane cell denies it ('fork/exec /bin/ps: operation not permitted'). 8 faketmux tests fail in every lane cell with or without a change, so no lane can verify a faketmux change, and an item that asks for the faketmux suite fails audit as infra-systemic. The console host runs ps, so the suite passes there and in CI.
title: the faketmux reaper execs /bin/ps, so a lane cell cannot run the faketmux suite
